description: This file defines data structures related to cgroup statistics, including CPU, memory, blkio, and other resource metrics, for use in container resource management.

classes.name: ThrottlingData
classes.description: Holds throttling period counts and throttled time for cgroups.

classes.name: BurstData
classes.description: Contains data about bandwidth bursts in cgroups.

classes.name: CpuUsage
classes.description: Represents CPU usage metrics, including total and per-core usage in user and kernel modes.

classes.name: PSIData
classes.description: Contains pressure stall information metrics over different intervals.

classes.name: PSIStats
classes.description: Holds PSIData for some and full pressure stall information.

classes.name: CpuStats
classes.description: Aggregates CPU usage, throttling, PSI, and burst data.

classes.name: CPUSetStats
classes.description: Details CPU and memory node allocations and flags for a cgroup's cpuset.

classes.name: MemoryData
classes.description: Memory usage metrics including current, max, fail count, and limit.

classes.name: MemoryStats
classes.description: Comprehensive memory statistics, including cache, swap, kernel, and NUMA page usage.

classes.name: PageUsageByNUMA
classes.description: Memory page usage per NUMA node, with hierarchical structure.

classes.name: PageUsageByNUMAInner
classes.description: Inner structure for NUMA page usage details.

classes.name: PageStats
classes.description: Statistics for memory pages, including total and per-node counts.

classes.name: PidsStats
classes.description: Tracks current and limit of process IDs in a cgroup.

classes.name: BlkioStatEntry
classes.description: Represents block IO statistics entries.

classes.name: BlkioStats
classes.description: Aggregates block IO statistics, including service bytes, time, and sectors.

classes.name: HugetlbStats
classes.description: Memory usage stats for huge pages.

classes.name: RdmaEntry
classes.description: Represents RDMA device limits and current usage.

classes.name: RdmaStats
classes.description: Holds RDMA device statistics.

classes.name: MiscStats
classes.description: Miscellaneous resource usage and event counts.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Main structure aggregating all resource statistics for a cgroup.

classes.name: NewStats
classes.description: Constructor function to initialize a new Stats object.

methods.name: NewStats
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Stats object with empty maps.
